definition: Galactocentric radius beyond which disc stars are still detected at 99.7% confidence (LAMOST and APOGEE metallicity distributions); the same analysis finds them beyond 31 kpc at 95.4%.
quote: Disk stars at R > 26 kpc (99.7% C.L.)
presentation: Where the galaxy's stars are still measured: while the camera is inside this radius the galaxy's caption hides; outside it the caption hangs under what is drawn of the galaxy. Not a boundary.
